name: PayPal Partner App
description: PayPal Partner App is an approved multiparty platform identity used to onboard sellers, receive delegated permissions and facilitate payments, fees, payouts, disputes or other merchant operations.
agentUseSummary: This partner financial-control model is visible as a canonical PayPal extension preview. Relay will not collect partner credentials, onboard merchants or expose delegated money movement beside the bounded canonical PayPal reads.

capabilities.label: Use an approved PayPal partner platform
capabilities.description: If partner support is approved, extend the canonical PayPal connector with immutable platform, seller, environment, product, feature and delegated-permission binding.

blocked.label: Create duplicate PayPal provider state
blocked.description: A partner-app listing must not create parallel merchant tokens, tools or approvals beside Relay's canonical PayPal connector.

blocked.label: Capture PayPal partner credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask a platform operator to paste partner client secrets, access tokens, merchant assertions or seller credentials into this Marketplace alias.

blocked.label: Onboard or consent a PayPal seller
blocked.description: Creating referral links, pre-filling seller data, granting delegated permissions, accepting legal consents and checking eligibility are operator workflows outside Relay agent actions.

blocked.label: Move funds or exercise partner features
blocked.description: Payments, refunds, partner fees, payouts, delayed disbursement, disputes, chargebacks and seller account changes are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run PayPal partner actions from the setup alias
blocked.description: This alias exposes no runtime actions; approved partner support must extend the canonical connector with exact platform, seller, environment, permission and financial-policy binding.

approvalProfiles.label: PayPal partner financial-control review
approvalProfiles.description: This partner alias is not connectable. Delegated merchant authority remains unavailable until Relay is provider-approved and has a legally reviewed, least-privilege and auditable multiparty product.

runtimeSupport.description: This alias installs no OpenClaw tools; partner authority must extend the canonical PayPal provider pack after approval and financial review.

providerSetup.blocker: PayPal partner apps are approved multiparty financial platforms. They onboard sellers, request delegated features and products, receive merchant consent, attribute transactions and can facilitate payments, refunds, fees, payouts, disputes or delayed disbursement. Live use requires PayPal partner approval, and Relay's canonical merchant connector intentionally excludes partner features.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep using merchant-owned REST app credentials on the canonical PayPal connector for bounded reads. Any partner product requires PayPal and legal/compliance approval; immutable platform/seller/environment binding; provider-hosted consent and seller checks; exact products/features; onboarding and revocation webhooks; no seller-secret capture; dual control for money movement; limits, reconciliation, audit and typed tools.

evidence.supports: PayPal describes multiparty solutions as approved platform products for seller onboarding, partner fees, payouts, disputes and chargebacks; sandbox testing precedes provider approval for live use.
PayPal requires sellers to grant the platform delegated permissions determined by configured products and partner features such as payment, refund, delayed disbursement, fees and disputes.
PayPal's Partner Referrals flow creates provider-hosted signup, tracks seller eligibility and delegated permissions, and uses onboarding-completed and partner-consent-revoked webhooks.
PayPal permits sandbox testing before approval but requires an approved partner and configured live platform account before multiparty APIs work in production.
